_comment_intensity: Gap = time from END of the spoken callout to the START of the next one. This is EXECUTION time, not rest. Formula: baseGapMs + (perActionMs * combo.actions).
_comment_intensity_base: baseGapMs raised by 300 after Phase 0: iOS was silently adding ~317ms of audio-session startup to every gap, so the timing that felt right on the bag was really base+300. Holding the audio session warm removed that, so it is added back explicitly. See PHASE0-REPORT.md section 5.
_comment_intensity_perAction: perActionMs is deliberately the SAME at every intensity. It represents the time to physically throw one strike, which does not change because the user picked Hard. It was previously 700/600/500, which compressed execution time on harder settings — the shortfall multiplied by combo length and made 7-action combos impossible to complete on Hard. Intensity is now expressed purely through baseGapMs, i.e. how much recovery you get on top of the execution. If a whole intensity feels wrong, move its baseGapMs. Only move perActionMs if LONG combos feel wrong while SHORT ones feel right.
_comment_frequency: Relative selection weight within a tier. NOT an absolute calls-per-minute rate.
_comment_tierWeights: Probability of drawing from each tier, relative to the tier the user selected. Renormalised over whichever tiers actually exist for the selection.
_comment_noRepeat: A combo id drawn within the last N calls is rejected and redrawn, up to maxRedraws attempts, then accepted anyway (guards against tiny pools).
_comment_lookahead: Do not begin a new callout if the estimated time to speak it plus its gap would overrun the remaining round time by more than this. Prevents a combo being cut off by the bell.
_comment_voiceSpeed: voiceSpeedPct 0-100 maps linearly onto SpeechSynthesisUtterance.rate across this range.
_comment_speechEstimate: How long a callout will take to speak, used ONLY by the round-end lookahead. estimatedMs = (fixedMs + msPerChar * characters) / rate. Fitted to measured iOS Safari speech in Phase 0 (predicted 1019ms vs 1022ms measured; all five test combos within ~5%). Refit if the voice or default speed changes substantially.
_comment_voiceCandidates: Preferred voice names per gender, in order. Matched case-insensitively as substrings against available en-* voices. Falls back to the first en voice, then the system default. Availability varies by device and iOS version, so never hard-code a name in logic.
_comment_speechVolume: Volume of spoken combo callouts, 0.0 to 1.0. Lowered from 1.0 so background music stays audible under the voice — iOS ducks other audio during speech and there is no web API to prevent it, but a quieter voice shifts the balance.
_comment_audio: Phase 0 finding: iOS tears down the system audio session ~2s after speech ends, costing ~317ms to restart (and ~631ms if a request lands exactly on the boundary). An inaudible tone held open for the workout keeps start latency at ~15ms. Frequency and gain are below audibility but must be non-zero.
_comment_pronunciation: Case-insensitive whole-word substitutions applied to the SPEECH string only, never the display string. Seeded with likely offenders; extend as Phase 0 and real use surface more.
